clock_method: Stats mapped using each Start printer epoch/monotonic anchor. Raw monitor restricted to matching OS boot offset and eventtime window. Client clock about 4-5 s ahead of printer wall clock.

gcode_heating_commands.command: PRINT_START T0_PURGE_TEMP=260 T0_MATERIAL="ABS" TOOL_TEMP=260 T0_TEMP=260     BED_TEMP=105 TOOL=0 MATERIAL=ABS

operator_information: Same mainboard, bed wiring and SSR retained during StealthChanger upgrade; no rewiring or SSR replacement reported.
conclusion: Intermittent bed measurement-path fault remains. No large jumps reproduced in the ten-minute printing monitor. Bed-only spikes with PB1 chamber stable narrow the suspect path but do not distinguish NTC/cable/contact, PB0 input circuit or local interference. SSR switching and global supply faults not established.
limitations: No independent thermometry, oscilloscope or resistance measurements.
Read-only capture; no controlled load switching or tool changes during monitor.
Raw Stats about 1 Hz can miss subsecond events. API heater temperature is additionally smoothed (3 s).
PWM is commanded duty, not measured SSR/AC current. Correlation does not prove causal direction.
